acceptance_rule: A new visitor can tell that ND Oracle contains things such as conditions, books, games and apps, and can reach them without first learning what “Resources”, “Topics”, “Needs” or similar internal categories mean.

first_decision_area.rule: Concrete visitor-recognisable categories are primary. Internal information-architecture terms are not required knowledge.

primary_categories.label: Conditions
primary_categories.purpose: Learn about named neurodivergent or neurodevelopmental conditions and related explanations.

primary_categories.label: Books
primary_categories.purpose: Find fiction, memoir, practical and informational books in the governed Resource catalogue.

primary_categories.label: Games
primary_categories.purpose: Find governed game Resources without first browsing the generic Resource catalogue.

primary_categories.label: Apps & tools
primary_categories.purpose: Find governed software, accessibility tools and practical tools.

primary_categories.label: Organisations & peer groups
primary_categories.purpose: Find organisations, communities and peer-support routes.

primary_categories.label: Work & education
primary_categories.purpose: Find practical support for work, study, adjustments and education.

primary_categories.label: Health & diagnosis
primary_categories.purpose: Find assessment, diagnosis, healthcare access and health-support routes.

primary_categories.label: Daily living
primary_categories.purpose: Find practical help with everyday activities, sensory needs, communication, food, sleep, money and mobility.

primary_categories.label: Evidence & research
primary_categories.purpose: Inspect governed evidence, sources, uncertainty and authority boundaries.

overlap_rules: Resource-kind routes (Books, Games, Apps & tools, Organisations & peer groups) classify by governed Resource category; cross-links may expose the same item from a practical route without cloning authority.
Conditions is for learning about a named condition or condition-oriented explanation; Health & diagnosis is for assessment, diagnosis process, healthcare access or clinical support.
Work & education and Daily living are task/context routes. They may reference Resources and Questions but never duplicate the governed object.
Evidence & research is the authority/evidence route and never acts as a recommendation or ranking surface.
When more than one visitor route applies, retain one governed object and expose multiple deterministic links rather than creating duplicate content.

choices: Something to read, watch or use
Somewhere or someone that can help
uncertainty_route.rule: Every choice resolves to existing governed content; this route must not become another full taxonomy.

terminology_rule: Internal/system terms may remain as compatibility or specialist routes, but a new visitor must not need to understand them to reach ordinary content.
hierarchy_rule: Primary content categories → secondary utilities → deeper/internal browsing tools.
visual_rules: Use colour plus non-colour structure to separate meaningful sections.
Retain the readable base text size; use weight and hierarchy for importance.
Avoid whitespace that separates mutually dependent information.
The Home surface communicates content types before project explanation or methodology.
Recognition imagery is secondary to the category label and remains rights-gated.
imagery_rule: Render a cleared visual when it materially helps the user recognise, distinguish or understand the resource.
implementation_boundary: Phase 1 freezes presentation/navigation authority only. Actual Home/category route implementation belongs to Phase 2.

human_acceptance.first_question: Without clicking anything, what kinds of things do you think you can find on this website?
human_acceptance.rule: Automated tests and screenshots cannot satisfy the real-human gate; repair only demonstrated usability problems, not aesthetic preference alone.
